p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('class Intake')]
new='''# Providers whose retries arrive with a new event id (e.g. harbor resends
# po_1844 as po_1844.2) but the same Idempotency-Key header. For these the
# header, not the body event id, is the replay identity.
# northwind stays on the 8-char prefix it has used since the 2024 retry
# incident (PAY-333); new providers use the full key so that distinct payouts
# sharing a prefix are not dropped as duplicates.
HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind", "harbor"})
_KEY_PREFIX = {"northwind": 8}


def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS and hook.idempotency_key:
        prefix = _KEY_PREFIX.get(hook.provider)
        return hook.idempotency_key[:prefix] if prefix else hook.idempotency_key
    # Other providers resend the original event id on retry (PAY-220), so the
    # body id is their replay identity.
    return hook.event_id


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9e11111111", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2
EOF
